# Buoy Health

> Buoy Health is an AI-powered symptom checker and digital health platform that guides users to appropriate care options through intelligent medical assessment.

Buoy Health combines artificial intelligence with medical expertise from Harvard-trained physicians to provide accessible symptom assessment and health guidance. The platform serves as a digital health assistant, helping users understand their symptoms and navigate healthcare options.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered symptom checker
- Digital health diagnosis
- Medical education
- Symptom assessment
- Healthcare navigation
- Self-care guidance
- Medical content
- Health conditions
- Data protection
- HITRUST certification
- Buoy Assistant
- Doctor reviews
- Respiratory health
- Care guidance

## Core Platform

- [Buoy Health: Check Symptoms & Find the Right Care](https://www.buoyhealth.com): Buoy's AI-powered symptom checker guides users to appropriate care options
- [Here's how Buoy works](https://www.buoyhealth.com/how-it-works): Explains Buoy's symptom assessment, care guidance, and follow-up support

## Medical Education & Health Guides

- [Lower Left Abdomen Pain 9 Possible Causes](https://www.buoyhealth.com/learn/pain-lower-left-abdomen): Medical guide to lower left abdominal pain causes and relief options
- [Headache Relief | How to Stop a Headache: Tension, Sinus & Migraine](https://www.buoyhealth.com/learn/23-headache-remedies-comprehensive-list): Comprehensive headache relief guide covering remedies and treatment options
- [Painful Urination: What Causes Discomfort When Urinating?](https://www.buoyhealth.com/learn/painful-urination): Medical guide to painful urination causes including UTIs and kidney stones
- [STD or Not? 23 Reasons for STD Symptoms in Women](https://www.buoyhealth.com/learn/sti-or-not-reasons-for-std-symptoms-women): Educational guide differentiating STD and non-STD causes of symptoms
- [Common Skin Rashes | Causes & Treatments](https://www.buoyhealth.com/learn/rash): Guide to skin rash causes, treatments, and conditions like eczema, psoriasis
